verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt is served at docs.bentolabs.ai/llms.txt. The docs also offer agent-oriented paths: a paste-in prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Windsurf that installs Bento's Agent Skills and hands the agent the integration playbook, plus docs loaded over MCP and pages published as .md. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of an agent actually completing an integration from these docs, and detail on how the MCP docs server is set up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.
